headline: Brazil posts highest October trade surplus since 1989 on export growth
summary: Brazil recorded its largest October trade surplus since 1989, driven by rising exports, including an 11.4% increase in sales to the United States despite new tariffs.
why: Trade surplus expansions bolster foreign exchange reserves and support national current account balances, influencing sovereign currency stability.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: A record trade surplus strengthens the external sector of the economy.
